entities.name: Konrad Mägi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Konrad Vilhelm Mägi was an Estonian painter; one of the first modernist painters in Estonia and the Nordic countries, at the core of whose creative legacy are visionary landscapes. He only worked for sixteen years, yet the total volume of his oeuvre is estimated to be around 400 paintings.
